rows.07:5134:
......Pitch black.
My head hurts.
......What happened to me?
That's right!
Someone hit me from behind.
And I passed out...... Where am I?
I can't move.
My hands and feet seem to be tied.{p}
rows.07:525c:
......When I slowly opened my eyes, I was in the familiar newspaper club room.
I was tied hand and foot with rough rope to the club's big table.
And standing in front of me were seven people, boys and girls.
Faces I recognized.
It was Shindo and the others.
And in the middle of them......
"Yo, {a}. Finally awake, huh?"
Hino was standing there.
He was the newspaper club senior who had set up this meeting and gathered the seven members.
"Hino!"
"What's with the surprised face? That's a real dumb-looking mug you've got there.{p}
rows.07:626c:
Hino slipped something hard into my barely open mouth.
What......?
A capsule......?
Mmgh!
......I swallowed it.
Once they saw my throat bob as I swallowed, Hino and the others looked very satisfied.
"What you just swallowed is poison.
......Now, now, don't look so shocked.
You won't die right away. It's in a capsule.
But once your stomach acid dissolves the capsule and the poison inside gets out, that's it for you.
Nothing left to do but die.
......Let's see. By my calculations, you've got about five hours left before you die, I'd say."
Hino looked very pleased with himself.
"......Y-you're joking, right?"
I'm sure my voice sounded pathetic.
I would surely have done anything at all, if only they would tell me it was a joke.{p}
rows.07:69a4:
......There's no other way.
If I don't lick it, I won't survive.
I shut my eyes, swallowed my tears, and licked his shoe.
"Wahahahaha! Look at this guy! He's licking my shoe! Disgusting!
......Look, he's crying, this guy."
......For now, I have to endure whatever they say.
There's nothing I can do but endure.{p}
rows.07:6f88:
These guys, what kind of people are they!
They want to have fun watching me search like mad★
"I'll untie you now.
Listen, just because you're free, don't you lay a hand on us.
If you try anything against us, I'll smash that ampoule.
I'm the only one who knows where it's hidden.
And one more thing. Don't you dare leave the school.
If you so much as try to leave the school, I won't hesitate to get rid of the ampoule.
Go to the police or a hospital, nobody's going to take your story seriously.
There's only one way you can be saved.
Find the ampoule hidden somewhere in this school.
There's only one rule to keep.
Don't leave the school.{p}
rows.07:73d0:
"Hurry!"
"Hurry!"
"Hurry or you'll die!"
They all jeered at me together.
......I wanted to beat the hell out of them, but I didn't even have the time to spare for that.
For now, just like they said, finding the antidote came first.{p}
